# securitls Provider

Terraform provider for the SecuriTLS PKI and certificate lifecycle management API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    securitls = {
      source = "securitls/securitls"
    }
  }
}

provider "securitls" {
  api_key = "<YOUR API KEY>" # or set environment variable SECURITLS_API_KEY
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) SecuriTLS API key. Can also be set with SECURITLS_API_KEY.
- `base_url` (String) SecuriTLS API base URL. Defaults to https://securitls.com/api and can be set with SECURITLS_BASE_URL.
